About the Scholarship

The Skoll Scholarship at Saïd Business School funds MBA candidates with a demonstrated commitment to social entrepreneurship — typically at least one full award each year covering fees plus living costs. Selection happens through the Oxford MBA admission rounds, so your MBA application is the scholarship application; the final stage closes in January 2027.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

The Skoll Scholarship at Saïd Business School funds MBA candidates with a demonstrated commitment to social entrepreneurship — typically at least one full award each year covering fees plus living costs. Selection happens through the Oxford MBA admission rounds, so your MBA application is the scholarship application; the final stage closes in January 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Full MBA funding for social-impact entrepreneurs
  • No separate scholarship form — decided within MBA admission rounds
  • Saïd Business School's social-entrepreneurship ecosystem (Skoll Centre)
  • Final January deadline for the MBA round each cycle

Who Should Apply

MBA applicants with founder-level or leadership experience in social enterprises, impact ventures or mission-driven organisations.

Funding and Costs

Full course fees for the MBA plus a living-expenses grant for at least one Skoll Scholar each year.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply to the Oxford MBA in an early stage, complete the Skoll-related questions in the application, and target the January 2027 final round. Key deadline information: Considered automatically with the Oxford MBA application; final admission stage closes in January 2027.

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Saïd Business School, University of Oxford

Saïd Business School is the University of Oxford's business school, home to the Skoll Centre for Social Entrepreneurship and the Skoll Scholarship for MBA candidates with social-impact careers.

Official website: https://www.sbs.ox.ac.uk

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Automatic with MBA application - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
